31965-C.s: The bill amends the 2009 budget of the Provinciefonds (provincial fund), setting the commitment amount for the general and supplementary grants at €1,245,678,000 and adjusting expenditure and revenue lines. It enters into force on 1 June 2009, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant and supplementary grants is set at €1,245,678,000 for the 2009 grant year.

Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet terzake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2009 vastgesteld op € 1 245 678 000.

32003.s: The bill creates a new legal form, the 'vereniging' or 'stichting tot instandhouding van een maatschappelijke onderneming' (MO), a modality of association or foundation running enterprises serving public interest, with mandatory supervisory board, stakeholder representation, and possibility of profit-sharing winstbewijzen with private investors. It amends Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code and related laws (Wet op de economische delicten, Handelsregisterwet, Vennootschapsbelasting) to accommodate this form.
32003.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to governance codes and designated public funds by the need for sector-specific flexibility and to preserve public money for its intended purpose.
q: The articles of association may give further rules that the board must observe when deciding on a profit distribution.
De statuten kunnen nadere voorschriften gegeven worden waaraan het bestuur zich dient te houden als het besluit tot winstuitkering.
d: designation of governance code for categories of social enterprises
designation of public funds protected from profit distribution
further rules on contents of annual report and accounts
exemption from obligation to prepare annual accounts for good reasons
p: Internal decision approval and dispute resolution are left to articles of association rather than statute, with a private dispute regime required.
Governance codes that define stakeholder involvement can be designated by administrative order, shaping the rules for enterprises without parliamentary debate.

v.summary: The Council of State advised against the draft bill creating a foundation or association maintaining a social enterprise (VSMO), finding the concept of social enterprise too vague, the added value unclear, and the existing public-law and self-regulatory frameworks sufficient. The government's reply (nader rapport) rejects the Council's view on recognisability, legal guarantees and scope, and adopts several textual changes including on enquiry rights, tax treatment and the appointment of supervisory members.
concerns: The Council doubts the added value of the new legal form, since existing legal forms plus public-law rules or self-regulation achieve the same results.
The Council finds the notion of 'maatschappelijke onderneming' insufficiently defined and asks for clarification of its meaning and scope.
The Council raises numerous drafting and consistency points, including the term commissaris, the profile requirement and the wording on statutory amendments, most of which the government adopted.
The Council criticises giving the minister power to request an enquiry and asks for its removal; the government retained it with an explanation.
The Council notes the broad enquiry right and the possible implications for belanghebbenden, which the government addresses only partly.

32021.s: The bill amends the Judicial Organisation Act, the Judicial Divisions Act and several procedural codes following the evaluation of judicial modernisation: it creates a complaints procedure against judicial officials before the Supreme Court, lets the Council for the Judiciary designate and reassign courts and sub-locations, raises the small-claims jurisdiction from €5,000 to €25,000, and allows temporary reallocation of cases by ministerial regulation for up to two years. It also reorganises court districts and court sectors and adds ministerial power to direct and annul certain Council decisions.
32021.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary reallocation powers by the need to respond to structural capacity shortages while keeping the Council and minister accountable, and frames the ministerial annulment and direction powers as ultimum remedium safeguards for accessible justice.
q: To bring about this general administrative order, use can be made if necessary of the extra year provided by the extension option.
Om deze amvb tot stand te brengen, kan zo nodig gebruik worden gemaakt van het extra jaar waarin de verlengingsmogelijkheid voorziet.
d: Ministerial power to annul Council decisions on case allocation and sub-locations
Minister may issue general and specific directions to the Council on sub-locations
ARTIKEL III, onderdeel G (artikel 108a BRv); ARTIKEL VI; ARTIKEL VII; ARTIKEL VIII
Designate a different district court for a category of cases for up to two years
Designate a different court of appeal for a category of cases for up to two years
Exempt courts from the presidency-membership rule; minister may reassign a category of criminal cases
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel J (artikel 46a) and onderdeel U (artikel 62a)
Council for the Judiciary temporarily designates other courts to hear categories of cases
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel I (artikel 41) and onderdeel T (artikel 59)
Council for the Judiciary designates sub-locations and sets rules on filing documents
College of Procurators-General may assign joint organisational tasks to prosecution offices
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel Y (artikel 75) and CC (artikel 96a), EE (artikel 120)
Supreme Court, Council, Procurator-General adopt complaints procedures
Fix the number of Council members between three and five
Board sets opening hours of sub-location registries in board rules
p: The minister may, by royal decree, annul Council for the Judiciary decisions on sub-locations and case referrals when they are manifestly contrary to law or to good access to justice.
The minister may give general and specific directions to the Council on the designation of sub-locations where access to justice requires it.
ARTIKEL III, onderdeel G (artikel 108a); ARTIKEL VI; ARTIKEL VII; ARTIKEL VIII
Ministerial regulation may move categories of cases to other courts for up to two years on a finding of persistent capacity shortage, with a sunset limit but without parliamentary approval.
Temporary exemption from the rule on court presidency membership and ministerial reassignment of criminal case categories, expiring three years after entry into force.
Creates a complaints procedure before the Supreme Court against conduct of judicial officials, strengthening citizens' protection, with annual reporting.

parties: Questions whether the bill anticipates the judicial map debate and asks how parliament keeps democratic control over designating court locations.
What are the instruments if it turns out the Council for the Judiciary pays insufficient attention to good geographic distribution?
Wat zijn de instrumenten als blijkt dat de Raad van de Rechtspraak onvoldoende oog heeft voor een goede geografische spreiding?

Wants the Minister rather than the Council for the Judiciary to designate sub-district court sectors and locations, and questions removing the statutory sector requirement before the effects of the higher limit are known.

Particularly where sub-district court matters are concerned, these members find that sub-district courts should be designated by the Minister under the current arrangement and not by the Council for the Judiciary.

Met name daar waar het kantonrechtspraak betreft, vinden deze leden dat de kantongerechten moeten worden aangewezen door de Minister volgens de huidige regeling en niet door de Raad van de Rechtspraak.

Opposes loosening statutory anchoring of court locations and the €25,000 jurisdiction increase, fearing budget-driven closures and insufficient study of effects; wants a complaints channel analysed and external oversight kept accessible.
In their view, letting go carries the risk that under imposed budget cuts the Council for the Judiciary will, of necessity, look for savings at the locations not anchored in law.

Naar hun mening schuilt in het loslaten het gevaar dat door middel van opgelegde bezuinigingen de Raad voor de rechtspraak, noodgedwongen, ruimte voor bezuinigingen gaat zoeken bij de niet wettelijk verankerde vestigingsplaatsen.
Asks whether the jurisdiction increase will be evaluated, what extra burden it places on the judiciary, and what quality safeguards apply to non-advocate legal providers.
These members would like to know whether the government will evaluate whether the benefit of lowering the threshold outweighs its possible disadvantages.
Deze leden zouden graag vernemen of door de regering geëvalueerd gaat worden of het voordeel van de verlaging van de drempel opweegt tegen de eventuele nadelen ervan.
Supports the general thrust but questions the sharp rise in the sub-district court limit and the removal of the sector requirement, asking for justification.
Nevertheless, the parts aimed at raising the sub-district judge's jurisdiction limit and abolishing the sub-district sector have given rise to doubts and questions.

Niettemin hebben de onderdelen die strekken tot verhoging van de competentiegrens van de kantonrechter en tot afschaffing van de sector kanton (schrapping van artikel 47 Wet RO) aanleiding gegeven tot twijfels en vragen.
Asks whether a higher jurisdiction limit creates inequality of arms where one party has legal assistance and the other does not.
These members ask the government to explain whether the planned increase of the jurisdiction limit to €25,000 entails risks regarding inequality between parties.

Deze leden verzoeken de regering nader in te gaan op de vraag of de voorgenomen verhoging van de competentiegrens tot € 25 000 risico's met zich meebrengt ten aanzien van de ongelijkheid van partijen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill's temporary power to change relative jurisdiction by AMvB should carry a maximum duration in law, and questioned the fivefold increase of the kanton jurisdiction limit and the extension of the complaints right to non-judicial officials. The minister accepted the time limit (two years), extended the justification for the jurisdiction increase, clarified that the Nationale ombudsman remains competent for certain officials, and added a corrective power over the Raad voor de rechtspraak.
concerns: Temporary changes to relative jurisdiction by AMvB should not be open-ended; a maximum duration should be set in the law.
The fivefold increase of the kanton competence limit to EUR 25,000 needs better analysis of effects on legal representation, the rechtzoekende and the caseload, and consideration of phasing.
Extending the complaints right to non-judicial officials departs from the Nationale ombudsman's competence without convincing justification; this should be motivated per category.

32210.s: The bill amends the Dutch higher education act to replace the accreditation system with a two-regime model: institutions with a positive institutional quality assessment (instellingstoets kwaliteitszorg) get limited programme accreditation, while others remain under full accreditation. It also lets the minister revoke accreditations, adds conditional approvals and remedial periods, and creates a transitional regime for the introduction period.
32210.j: The memorandum justifies the conditional and revocation powers as needed for effective quality control and as a last resort, while limiting general discretion through an AMvB and the general administrative law framework.
q: Therefore this bill proposes giving the minister the power to revoke granted accreditation, new-programme approval or institutional quality assessment as a last resort.

Daarom wordt in dit wetsvoorstel voorgesteld de minister de bevoegdheid te geven om – als ultimum remedium – de verleende accreditatie, toets nieuwe opleiding of instellingstoets kwaliteitszorg in te trekken.
d: cases and conditions for conditional new-programme approval
cases and conditions for conditional institutional quality assessment
p: The minister may revoke an accreditation or new-programme approval on NVAO advice, a power previously held by the independent accreditation body, after hearing the institutional board.
The accreditation framework needs ministerial approval, which may be withheld for conflict with law or the public interest, after a four-week parliamentary pre-submission period.
The minister may once extend accreditation periods for designated programmes by up to two years, after consulting the NVAO and VSNU.
Removes the inspectorate's power to attend NVAO meetings, reducing oversight of the accreditation body.

parties: Asks how to guarantee that administrative burden actually falls and how expert panels avoid one-sided composition; supports ministerial withdrawal only on NVAO recommendation.
They believe that this step may only be taken if the NVAO recommends the minister to take it.
Deze leden menen echter dat deze stap uitsluitend gezet mag worden als de NVAO de minister aanbeveelt om die stap te zetten.
Asks why participation in institutional audit is voluntary and what the role of NVAO is when the minister can withdraw accreditation.
The members ask why a voluntary regime was chosen and why not a mandatory one.
De leden vragen waarom is gekozen voor een vrijwillig regime en waarom niet voor een verplicht regime.
Questions independence and selection of NVAO expert panels, asks for mandatory training and shorter three-year grace period for weak programmes.
Asks for safeguards around withdrawal decisions, legal protection against withdrawal, and whether the AMvB will be pre-submitted to parliament.
Is it not precisely with such a weighty instrument of great importance that it is surrounded with the right safeguards?
Is het niet juist bij zo'n zwaarwegend instrument van groot belang dat deze met de juiste waarborgen is omkleed?
Asks how the goal of reducing administrative burden will be achieved given pilots showed no substantial reduction.
The members ask the government to explain in more detail how one of the main objectives of this bill will be achieved.
De leden vragen de regering nader toe te lichten op welke wijze voldaan zal worden aan één van de belangrijkste doelstellingen van dit wetsvoorstel.
Doubts students can be independent expert panel members and questions the durability of the optional regime.
These members believe that expertise and independence cannot be guaranteed for persons who are themselves still part of the education process.
Deze leden menen dat de deskundigheid en onafhankelijkheid niet gewaarborgd kunnen worden van personen die zelf nog deel uitmaken van het onderwijsproces.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion of 27 February 2009 on a bill amending the Higher Education and Research Act to adapt the accreditation system advises reconsidering the bill, raising concerns on timing, the effectiveness of institutional accreditation, the NVAO's expanded powers, the role of the Inspectorate and VBI's, and legal protection. The government's nader rapport of 5 November 2009 responds point by point, largely defending the bill while adopting several changes such as explicit appeal rights against differentiated assessments.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for a reasoned justification why the accreditation system must change now, given pilot results and the Flemish timetable; the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum but kept the timing.

The Afdeling doubts that institutional accreditation will reduce bureaucracy and improve teaching quality and advises reconsidering its introduction; the government disagrees and retains the institutional quality review.

The Afdeling finds the NVAO's expanded discretion and powers, including proposing withdrawal of accreditation, too wide for an independent administrative body; the government limits discretion via an AMvB but keeps the withdrawal advisory role with the minister.

The Afdeling advises that differentiated quality ratings (excellent, good) be limited to whether programmes meet minimum requirements, since ranking should be left to peers; the government rejects this and keeps differentiated judgments.
The Afdeling asks that differentiated ratings and special features form part of the accreditation decision so that legal protection applies; the government adopted this change.

The Afdeling asks for clarification of the respective roles of the Inspectorate and NVAO, which overlap; the government clarifies the division of tasks and removes the Inspectorate's right to attend NVAO meetings.
The Afdeling asks for a clear choice between free competition and strict regulation of VBI's; the government sees no need to regulate VBI's since institutions choose them freely.

32395-E.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget statement of the AOW savings fund (Spaarfonds AOW) by a supplementary budget following the spring memorandum, changing the total income and expenditure line by -932 thousand euro. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 June 2010, with retroactive effect where the gazette appears later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has emerged for an amendment to the budget statement of the AOW savings fund for the year 2010
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Spaarfonds AOW voor het jaar 2010

32565-F.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds), adding supplementary expenditure and receipts for animal disease control and welfare, as shown in an attached supplementary budget table. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force from 1 December 2010, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The budget statement of the Animal Health Fund for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Diergezondheidsfonds voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32780-G.s: The bill amends the 2011 budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds (VAT compensation fund) by reducing spending by 15,517 thousand euro, in line with the Spring Memorandum. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force from 1 June 2011, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The change in the current year, which carries structurally into subsequent years, is technical in nature.
De mutatie in het lopende jaar, die structureel doorwerkt naar de opeenvolgende jaren, is technisch van aard

33011.s: The bill creates a statutory basis in the Municipalities Act for municipalities to charge fees for handling Dutch identity card applications, retroactively from the day after the Supreme Court ruling of 9 September 2011 of this 2011 ruling. It also provides that no fees are charged for applications filed between 9 September 2011 and the retroactive effective date, and makes existing municipal fee regulations rest on the new basis.
33011.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary after the Supreme Court ruling removed the legal basis for fees, providing a clear statutory grounding and a rule for the period before its entry into force.
q: We, having heard the Council of State advisory division and in common consultation with the States General, have resolved and decided as follows.
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan
d: municipal taxes (fees) for identity card application handling
municipal fee ordinance for identity card applications
p: Gives municipalities a statutory basis to levy fees on identity card applications, extending their fiscal discretion, with the retroactive effect validating past charges.
Makes the Passport Act and a general administrative order cover the fees, retroactively legitimising charges that the courts had found unlawful.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports a bill creating a statutory basis for municipalities to charge fees for Dutch identity cards after the Hoge Raad ruled leges could not be levied under the Gemeentewet, but advises clarifying the character of the charge, compensating municipalities for financial losses, and adding a transitional provision. The government's nader rapport reports that the bill was amended accordingly, adding references to articles 229b and 229c, compensation consultation with VNG, and a transitional provision.
concerns: The Afdeling advised a transitional provision so that requests submitted before the bill's introduction are handled under the existing legal situation, and the government added such a provision in article 2, third paragraph.

The Afdeling advised compensating municipalities for financial disadvantages arising from the inability to levy fees and clarifying this in the explanatory memorandum, which the government addressed through consultation with VNG.

The Afdeling noted the unclear character of the charge and advised declaring the conditions for rechten in article 229 Gemeentewet applicable, including the rule that estimated benefits may not exceed estimated costs, which the government addressed by adding references to articles 229b and 229c.

33200.s: The bill introduces a new funding arrangement for adult vocational students aged 30 and over in the work-based learning route of secondary vocational education, limiting state funding to a maximum of two years and shifting part of the costs to employers and students. It amends the Dutch Education and Vocational Education Act, the Tuition Fees Act and the Wage Tax Reduction Act, and sets transitional rules for current students.
33200.j: The memorandum justifies the new arrangement by the government's view that education for working people is primarily the responsibility of employers and employees, and the budget needs to be contained; it says the enrolment cap would be used only if the number of 30+ students rises disproportionately.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order a maximum may be set per institution for the number of participants aged 30 or over
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kan per instelling een maximum worden vastgesteld voor het aantal deelnemers van 30 jaar of ouder
d: maximum number of students aged 30+ per institution eligible for funding
parts of vocational programmes not required for students aged 30+
adjustment of the per-course education tax reduction amount when student numbers exceed 47,000
higher tuition fee tariff for students aged 30+ in work-based route, set by order in council or ministerial regulation
p: Allows the executive by general administrative order to cap the number of eligible 30+ students per institution using a calculation method left to be set later.

parties: Asks the government to justify the choice of financing 47,000 places, the unequal fiscal treatment of publicly and privately funded students, and the allocation of places.
How are the available 47,000 training places distributed among institutions and students, and who decides that?
Hoe worden de beschikbare 47 000 opleidingsplaatsen verdeeld over instellingen en studenten en wie bepaalt dat?
Criticises the bill as harming lifelong learning and asks whether the government would reduce funding for students who exceed the cap, questioning the fairness of that intervention.
How does the government justify such an intervention towards individual mbo students?
Hoe rechtvaardigt de regering zo'n ingreep tegenover individuele mbo'ers?
Asks whether the fiscal deduction limited to publicly funded education creates an uneven playing field and why a budget allocation key is not based on the prior year.
Asks whether there is not an unequal playing field because the fiscal wage-tax reduction for bbl applies only to publicly funded education.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of er niet sprake is van een ongelijk speelveld door de fiscale afdrachtvermindering bbl 5 (AV bbl) alleen van toepassing te laten zijn op het bekostigd onderwijs.
Asks whether the government will reconsider the 47,000 cap if more places are needed, and questions how the cap and the removal of loopbaan and burgerschap requirements work in practice.
The members ask whether the government is willing to reconsider the current proposal if, for good reasons, temporarily or otherwise, more than 47,000 training places are needed.
De leden vragen of de regering bereid is om het huidige voorstel te heroverwegen als op goede gronden, al dan niet tijdelijk, meer dan 47 000 opleidingsplaatsen nodig zijn.
Questions the internal contradiction of the bill with lifelong learning, why the exception applies only to bbl students, and how students are selected for funding.
The members ask why this exception applies only to bbl students.
De leden vragen waarom deze uitzondering enkel geldt voor bbl-studenten.
Fears the bill will harm lifelong learning ambitions and asks whether the 47,000 cap will counteract efforts to reduce staff shortages.
The D66 members share the government's finding that training enough workers is necessary given future staff shortages in care, agriculture and technology.

De leden van de D66-fractie delen de constatering van de regering dat het met het oog op de toekomstige personeelstekorten in de zorg, landbouw en techniek noodzakelijk is om voldoende werknemers op te leiden.
Asks why the cap is set at 47,000 and not based on yearly labour market needs, and whether institutions will have waiting lists or selection at the gate.
The members ask why the government chose to fund a maximum of 47,000 training places per year and what this number is based on.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen waarom is gekozen voor het bekostigen van maximaal 47 000 leerplaatsen per jaar en waar dit aantal op gebaseerd is.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering supports the bill limiting publicly funded vocational education (mbo) for students aged 30 and over, but objects that the proposed extension of the wage-tax reduction for employers adds fiscal complexity without a sufficiently demonstrated necessity, effectiveness, or consideration of budget-neutral alternatives, and advises adaptation. The minister's reply rejects the fiscal objection, arguing the employer contribution condition secures effectiveness and that employers share responsibility, while accepting several redactional corrections.
concerns: The Afdeling is not convinced of the necessity of the wage-tax reduction for work-based vocational education and finds no careful weighing of policy effectiveness and cost-efficiency; the minister says effectiveness is secured by the employer-contribution condition.

The Afdeling says the measure complicates the fiscal system and that a simpler budget-neutral alternative (smaller tuition increase without the fiscal facility) was not considered; the minister says the measure fits the existing fiscal structure and is implementable.

Several redactional and legislative-technical comments on articles II, III, IV and VIII were largely incorporated, with some suggested wording not adopted and a misunderstanding about transitional law clarified.

33480-I.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget statement of the Royal Household (begroting van de Koning) by adjusting the spending lines for the sovereign's constitutional allowance, functional expenditure and charged expenditure of other budgets. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 December 2012 or the date of publication.
q: The budget statement belonging to the budget of the King (I) for the year 2012 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De begrotingstaat behorende bij de begroting van de Koning (I) voor het jaar 2012 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33750-I.s: This bill sets the 2014 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Crown (Koning), fixing amounts in thousands of euros for the constitutional allowance to royal family members and the functional expenditure of the Dienst van het Koninklijk Huis. It contains no substantive delegation of rule-making power beyond budget administration.
q: The budget statement attached to this act for the year 2014 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2014 wordt vastgesteld.

33750-XVIII.s: This bill is the 2014 budget act for the Ministry of Housing and Civil Service (Wonen en Rijksdienst), setting the expenditure and revenue estimates for its policy articles and the baten-lastenagentschappen budgets, and adding this budget to the national budget. It also lists the regulatory bodies and statutory tasks under the minister's oversight and sets the entry-into-force rule.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the 2014 budget bill for Housing and Central Government Reform (XVIII) should be formally added to the national budget under the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, since it is adopted separately for the first time. The Minister of Finance's reply states that a supplementary article has been added as advised and that the budget's expenditure total was adjusted upward.
concerns: The Afdeling advises adding a provision to the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 so that the Housing and Central Government Reform budget is included in the Rijksbegroting, since it is adopted separately for the first time.

33805-H.s: The bill amends the 2013 budget statement of the BES-fund (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba) by adjusting its expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros. It also sets the entry-into-force date, with retroactive effect to 1 December 2013 under certain publication conditions.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the BES-fund (H) for the year 2013
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds (H), voor het jaar 2013

33930-I.s: This bill amends the 2013 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Royal Household (Koning I) by adjusting expenditure lines, mainly for pay and price developments and cost reallocations. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
33930-I.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget adjustment by noting that wage and price developments differed somewhat from what was assumed when the budget was drafted.
q: Because wage and price developments deviate somewhat from what was assumed when drafting the budget, the budget amount has been adjusted by 6.
Doordat de loon- en prijsontwikkeling enigszins afwijkt van datgene waarmee bij het opstellen van de begroting rekening is gehouden, is het begrotingsbedrag met 6 aangepast.

33940-H.s: The bill amends the 2014 budget statement of the BES-fonds (Caribbean Netherlands fund) by reducing expenditure and commitments by 803 thousand euro. It also sets the currency unit of the budget and the entry-into-force date of 1 June 2014 with retroactive effect provisions.
q: The budget statement BES-fonds for the year 2014 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat BES-fonds voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34000-IIB.s: This bill fixes the 2015 budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Overige Hoge Colleges van Staat and the Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs, covering the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the governors' cabinets in Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and the entry into force on 1 January 2015.
q: The budget statement for the year 2015 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34010.s: The bill modernises and simplifies Dutch secondary education hour requirements by setting minimum clock hours per school type over the whole programme rather than per year, and introduces a minimum of 189 teaching days per school year. It also moves holiday-day rules into a new article 6g1, allowing ministerial regulation to set holiday start and end dates and an AMvB to set further day rules, with a nahang procedure for the AMvB.
34010.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated holiday rules as technical arrangements that spread holidays across regions and keeps the AMvB subject to a nahang procedure, while shifting day-count supervision to general inspection risk-based oversight.
q: The fifth paragraph contains a so-called nahang provision, since this procedural rule also applies to the current second paragraph of article 22 WVO, whose content is moved to the proposed new article 6g1.
In het vijfde lid is een zogenoemde «nahangbepaling» opgenomen, aangezien dit procedurevoorschrift ook geldt ten aanzien van het huidige tweede lid van artikel 22 WVO
d: Artikel I, B (art. 6g1, derde lid WVO)
rules on holidays and other non-teaching days
Artikel I, B (art. 6g1, vierde lid WVO)
start and end dates of holidays; adjusted day counts per region
Artikel IV, B (art. 12b, derde en vierde lid WVO BES)
holiday and non-teaching day rules for Caribbean Netherlands

parties: Asks how schools will show progress per year and whether the flexibility allowed for teacher absence is a genuine pedagogical choice rather than a negative one.
The members do ask how schools can continue to make their progress per year clear to the pupil and their parents.
De leden vragen wel hoe de scholen hun voortgang per leerjaar duidelijk kunnen blijven maken aan de leerling en hun ouders.
Welcomes the government's response to the Chamber's call for maximum room for tailored provision and asks whether the end of 'ophokuren' is now definitive.
Can the government say that with its bill an definitive end will now come to the phenomenon of 'ophokuren', these members want to know.
Kan de regering zeggen dat met haar wetsvoorstel nu een definitief einde gaat komen aan het verschijnsel «ophokuren», willen deze leden weten.
Asks for an exact, transparent calculation basis for instructional time and how financing was calculated, and whether individual pupils could receive substantially fewer hours over a programme.
The members of the SP faction ask whether the government can exactly and clearly calculate the basis of the current calculation of instructional time.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of de regering exact en helder kan voorrekenen waarop de huidige berekening van de onderwijstijd is gebaseerd.
Asks whether the bill will again lead to 'ophokuren' and whether it keeps pace with digitalisation, including remote supervised instruction counting toward the norm.
After all, this phenomenon caused complaining parents and pupils and was the reason for tightening supervision of the hours norm.
Immers, dit fenomeen zorgde voor klagende ouders én leerlingen en was de aanleiding tot het aanscherpen van het toezicht op de urennorm.
Asks how per-programme compliance differs from a cohort approach when a school registers hours per year, and when inspection will look at instructional time specifically.
Can the government explain when exactly there are 'strong signals', these members ask.
Kan de regering toelichten wanneer precies sprake is van «sterke signalen», zo vragen deze leden.
Supports more flexibility and trust toward school boards, but questions whether administrative burden actually falls and whether schools that perform well are penalised for missed hours.
It is understandable that registration per cohort is not chosen because of the high administrative burden.
Het is begrijpelijk dat niet gekozen wordt voor registratie per cohort vanwege de hoge administratieve lasten.
Asks whether the cohort-level legal norm still applies and whether sanctions remain possible, so that schools are not suggested to be immune from external supervision.
These members would find it undesirable if the bill gave the suggestion that schools with regard to a cohort are no longer in any way liable to external supervision.
Deze leden zouden het onwenselijk vinden dat van het wetsvoorstel de suggestie uitgaat dat scholen ten aanzien van een cohort op geen enkele wijze meer vatbaar zijn voor extern toezicht.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports a bill modernising secondary-education hours by setting a per-programme hours norm, but objects that the cohort-free, per-school-year accountability makes enforcement impossible until programmes end and that no transitional regime exists for 2013/2014 and 2014/2015. The government's reply adds a clarification of accountability and enforcement in the explanatory memorandum and a transitional regime in which the inspectorate applies the new norm to those years, largely meeting the advice.
concerns: Accountability per school year makes enforcement of a whole-programme hours norm impossible before the programme ends, so the explanatory memorandum must explain enforcement and its relation to the programme norm.
The bill needs a clear transitional regime stating how the hours norm will be enforced for 2013/2014 and 2014/2015 and the margin schools have.

34100.s: The bill implements the Omnibus II directive by amending the Dutch Implementation Act for Solvency II and the Wft, adjusting EIOPA and ESMA roles, supervisory cooperation, and the regime for small insurers with limited risk scope. It also introduces transitional rules and adds powers for the Nederlandsche Bank and the European Parliament's inquiry committee to access confidential supervisory information.
34100.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to implement EU directive requirements and to give EIOPA and ESMA effective roles in supervision.
q: It amends the Implementation Act for the Solvency II Directive and the Implementation Act for the Financial Conglomerates I Directive, both of which amend the Wft.
Het wijzigt de Implementatiewet richtlijn solvabiliteit II en de Implementatiewet richtlijn financiële conglomeraten I die beide strekken tot wijzing van de Wet op het financieel toezicht (Wft).
d: exemptions from licensing requirements for insurers with limited risk scope
I, onderdeel CR / CH (art. 3:135 et seq. Wft)
rules on cross-border transfers of insurance portfolios and recovery plans
representatives and addresses of insurers with branches in the Netherlands
content, form and periodicity of intragroup reporting and adjusted solvency calculation
p: The Nederlandsche Bank may take measures against insurers when intragroup transactions threaten solvency, with reporting obligations attached.
The Nederlandsche Bank may exclude an undertaking from group supervision on several grounds, including misleading financial picture.
I, onderdeel A, subonderdeel 7 (art. 1:90 lid 8 Wft)
The supervisor provides confidential information to a temporary European Parliament inquiry committee, overriding the confidentiality rule.

parties: Asks how EIOPA and ESMA's powers and rule-making avoid them becoming regulators themselves, and why broad powers are delegated to the Commission rather than set in the directive.

How is it prevented that EIOPA and ESMA themselves become a kind of regulator, a criticism that also exists in the Netherlands regarding the supervisors DNB and AFM, ask the members of the VVD faction.

Hoe wordt voorkomen dat EIOPA en ESMA zelf een soort regelgevers gaan worden, kritiek die er in Nederland met betrekking tot de toezichthouders De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) en de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) ook wel is, vragen de leden van de fractie van de VVD.
Questions the breadth of delegated powers to the Commission, arguing broad descriptions are being used for what should be detailed lower-level rules.
The members of the PvdA faction note that this is a very broad description of what should only be detailed lower-level norms.
De leden van de fractie van de PvdA merken op dat dit een zeer brede omschrijving van wat slechts gedetailleerde lagere normeringen zouden moeten zijn.
Asks for clarification of the matching adjustment and why supervisory conditions and transitional restrictions apply, probing supervisory oversight.
Why is it permitted, under restrictions, not to immediately meet the solvency capital requirement upon entry into force of the Solvency II directive?
Waarom is het onder restricties toegestaan om bij de inwerkingtreding van de richtlijn solvabiliteit II nog niet meteen te voldoen aan het solvabiliteitskapitaalvereiste?
Warns that extending recovery periods for capital non-compliance could make insurers insolvent and harm consumers, and asks for the administrative burden to be made transparent.

These members ask whether capital requirements are precisely intended as a buffer in adverse market conditions, and whether extending non-compliance with the requirements results in an insurer becoming insolvent with all the adverse consequences.

Deze leden vragen de regering of kapitaalvereisten toch juist zijn bedoeld als buffer bij ongunstige marktomstandigheden en dat het verlengen van niet-naleving van de eisen juist tot gevolg heeft dat een verzekeraar insolvabel wordt met alle nadelige gevolgen van dien.
Asks for a full overview of cases in which EIOPA may exercise its power to assist national supervisors.
The members of the PVV faction ask how this will precisely be shaped and also request an overview of all cases in which EIOPA can exercise this power.
De leden van de fractie van de PVV vragen hoe dit precies zal worden vormgegeven en vragen tevens om een overzicht van alle gevallen waarin EIOPA deze bevoegdheid kan uitoefenen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the Omnibus II implementation bill for the Wft and the Solvency II implementing act but raises remarks on mandatory disclosure of confidential information to a European Parliament inquiry committee, vagueness of the 'bedenkingen' ground for refusing portfolio transfers, and the transparency of the bill's structure. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks: it makes disclosure mandatory, gives examples for 'bedenkingen', restructures the bill into amendments to the two implementing acts, and adds technical corrections on insurers with limited risk.
concerns: The discretionary power to share confidential supervisory information with a European Parliament inquiry committee does not match the mandatory obligation in the Omnibus II directive, so the provision was made mandatory.
The open term 'bedenkingen' as a ground for DNB to refuse a portfolio transfer lacks clarity, so examples were added to the explanatory memorandum though the term was kept.
The structure of the bill, amending two implementing acts rather than the Wft, is hard to follow, so the bill was restructured into a single article I for both acts.
Redactional remarks in the annex were taken into account.

34485-C.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), raising appropriations and revenues by about 141.5 million euros and setting the general and integration/decentralisation grant commitment amounts for 2016. It takes effect on 1 June 2016 with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Amendment of the budget of expenditure and revenue of the provinciefonds for the year 2016
Wijziging van de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2016

34550-J.s: This bill adopts the 2017 budget statement of the Deltafonds (Delta Fund), setting expenditure and revenue at about 905 million euros across investments in flood safety, freshwater supply, maintenance, water quality and overhead. It also includes the explanatory memorandum describing products, budget tables and the experimentation article under Deltawet article III.
34550-J.j: The memorandum justifies the experimentation article as enabling integrated implementation of the Deltaprogramma and integrated financing.
q: The experimentation article serves the integrated implementation of the Delta Programme and allows for integrated financing.
Het experimenteerartikel staat ten dienste van een integrale uitvoering van het Deltaprogramma en biedt de mogelijkheid tot integrale bekostiging.
d: spending from the Delta Fund on non-water policy measures via experimentation
p: The experimentation article allows Delta Fund money to be spent on nature, environment and economic measures beyond water safety, conditional on additional funding from other budgets or third parties.

34730-J.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds, the national delta fund for flood protection and water management, by adjusting appropriations and revenues in the first supplementary budget. It sets the statement's amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 June 2017 with retroactive effect where the gazette is published later.
q: The budget statement of the Deltafonds for the year 2017 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds voor het jaar 2017 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

34775-A.s: This bill is the 2018 budget act for the Infrastructuurfonds (Infrastructure Fund), setting the fund's expenditure and revenue estimates in thousands of euros for 2018. It fixes the budget schedule and enters into force on 1 January 2018 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Article 1 The budget schedule of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2018 attached to this act is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

34845-C.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2017 expenditure and revenue budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), setting new commitment amounts for general grants and integration and decentralisation grants. It also fixes the amounts in thousands of euros and sets the entry-into-force date of 1 December 2017.
q: The budget of expenditure and revenue of the provinciefonds for the year 2017 is amended, as shown in the budget statement attached to this law.
De begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2017 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat.

35000-IIA.s: This bill adopts the 2019 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Dutch States General (IIA), setting expenditure and revenue figures for its policy articles in thousands of euros. It takes effect on 1 January 2019 and contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The budget statement for the year 2019 belonging to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

35450-J.s: This bill amends the Deltafonds budget schedule for 2020 (first supplementary budget), shifting appropriations and receipts across Delta Fund articles on flood safety, freshwater supply, maintenance, experiments, and water quality. The explanatory memorandum explains the budget changes, such as a delayed Flevoland receipt and reallocations linked to the Voorjaarsnota 2020.
35450-J.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to unrealised receipts, the Raad van State PAS ruling and the Voorjaarsnota 2020, without any new delegation of powers.
q: In 2019 the receipt of EUR 1.5 million from the province of Flevoland for ecological measures in the Markermeer was not realised.
In 2019 is de ontvangst van € 1,5 miljoen van de provincie Flevoland voor ecologische maatregelen Markermeer niet gerealiseerd.

35925-C.s: This bill fixes the 2022 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) in euros and sets the commitment amounts for the general grant and integration/decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It also sets the entry-into-force date, with retroactive effect to 1 January if published late.
q: The commitment amount under Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant is fixed for grant year 2022 at € 2,487,642,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2022 vastgesteld op € 2.487.642.000.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2022 provincial fund budget bill (begrotingsstaat provinciefonds) and found no remarks, advising the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport of 20 September 2021 states the Afdeling has no objections to the blanco advice and notes some amendments to budgets are needed, referenced in attachments.

36250-K.s: The bill amends the 2022 expenditure budget of the Defence Materiel Fund (DMF) by lowering spending by €1,101.5 million relative to the first supplementary budget, with an acceleration of the Datacenter project of €11 million. It is the second supplementary budget, submitted alongside the Autumn Memorandum, and sets the amounts in thousands of euros with retroactive effect to 1 December 2022.
q: With this bill it is proposed to reduce the 2022 expenditure budget of the Defence Materiel Fund (K) compared with the first supplementary budget by €1,101.5 million.

Met het onderhavige wetsvoorstel wordt voorgesteld de uitgavenbegroting 2022 van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) ten opzichte van de 1e suppletoire begroting met een bedrag van € 1.101,5 miljoen te verlagen.

36350-J.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds (first supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across water safety, freshwater supply, maintenance, experimentation and water quality items. It does not delegate rule-making power or shift authority away from parliament or the courts; it is a budgetary adjustment set by Act of Parliament.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds, all for the year 2023.
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds, alle voor het jaar 2023.

36360-I.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the King (Slotwet) by adjusting appropriations for the constitutional allowance to members of the Royal House, functional expenditure of the King, and charged expenditure of other budgets, with the total budget changing from 48,203 to 49,739 thousand euros. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for retroactive effect to the end of 2022.
36360-I.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes by a technical indexation of the constitutional allowance based on the contract wage increase and the realised net salary of the vice-president of the Raad van State.
q: The draft budget of the King 2022 took into account an increase in the constitutional allowances in 2022 based on a technical indexation
In de ontwerpbegroting van de Koning 2022 is rekening gehouden met een stijging van de grondwettelijke uitkeringen in 2022 gebaseerd op een technische indexering

36600-L.s: The bill formally establishes the 2025 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Nationaal Groeifonds fund, in thousands of euros, with total expenditure of €2,691,095k and commitments of €393,158k. It also removes an obsolete article and abolishes the budget-feeding article for fund budgets, so the fund is treated like a departmental budget.
q: Article 1 The budget statement for the budget fund for the year 2025 attached to this act is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat inzake het begrotingsfonds voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

36800-J.s: This bill sets the 2026 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds, specifying commitments, expenditures and receipts by article in thousands of euros, and it takes effect on 1 January 2026. The memorandum explains the fund's experimentation article under the Deltawet, which allows Deltafonds spending on other policy areas when linked to water safety or freshwater supply and additionally financed.
36800-J.j: The memorandum justifies the experimentation article as enabling integrated execution of the Deltaprogramma and integrated financing, with the condition that measures be linked to water safety or freshwater supply and receive additional funding.
q: A condition is that these measures are connected to measures for water safety or freshwater supply and that there is additional financing from other government budgets or third parties.
Voorwaarde is wel dat deze maatregelen samenhangen met maatregelen ten behoeve van waterveiligheid of zoetwatervoorziening en dat er sprake is van additionele financiering

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the 2026 Deltafonds budget bill and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance, on behalf of the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, replies that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in attachments to the nader rapport.

36915-C.s: The bill amends the 2026 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) by a first supplementary budget, setting the general-fund obligation at €3,369,373,000 and decentralisation grants at €591,092,000 with retroactive effect to 1 June 2026. It is a budgetary adjustment that does not transfer legal powers between institutions.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2026
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2026
